verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs say it offers payment links (adyen-docs-24) and a Customer Area dashboard for managing the account (adyen-docs-16). The only documented way to create links, though, is programmatic, via the MCP server's create/get/expire tools (adyen-supp-mcp-tools). Nothing confirms links can be created no-code from the dashboard. Community reports of rejecting small clients and minimum monthly invoices cast doubt on a founder starting to sell immediately. Missing for 10: documented no-code payment-link creation in the Customer Area, evidence of fast self-serve onboarding to go live, hands-on corroboration of sharing a link and getting paid.
